messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person in the video with the person shown in the reference photo. Use the reference photo for facial identity, and make the body's skin tone consistent with the target person. Keep the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The woman faces the camera, blinks, and moves her mouth as if speaking, then tilts her head back to look upward.","camera":"The shot is a medium close-up at eye level, remaining mostly static with slight reframing as the subject moves.","clothing":"She is wearing a bright pink off-the-shoulder top with a black trim along the neckline.","hair_color":"The hair is a vivid orange-yellow color.","hairstyle":"She wears a bright orange bob with straight bangs and two rounded puffs at the sides.","identity":"A woman with a fair complexion, dark eyes, and red lipstick is shown from the chest up.","scene":"The background is a stylized, futuristic setting featuring a large dark dome structure with a glowing white ring and pink grid lines against a cloudy sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The subject's face and visible skin became much lighter and fairer, with red lipstick and different facial features, while the orange bob, puffs, pink off-shoulder top, futuristic background, head movements, and camera framing remained largely the same.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the person in the source video with the person from the reference photo, using the reference for facial identity and making the body skin tone consistent, while preserving the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether the new facial identity is an accurate match to the reference photo.
unexpected_changes: The output face appears fair-skinned with red lipstick, which does not clearly match the reference person's medium skin tone and natural lip color.
